notes: The initial complete N1 development run passed 22/22; this archive does not manufacture an initial failing production run.
Harness tests separately inject setup failure and a wrong observed XLSX cache value; these are test controls, not real-world run failures.

interpretation.actual_files: A XLSX raw formulas and persisted caches are read with openpyxl without invoking the runtime formula evaluator for expected answers. B produces JSON; its extra same-named XLSX is an isolation fixture, not a second XLSX delivery claim.
interpretation.independent_expectation: Fixed literals 10-4=6 and 12-4=8. The workbook is edited to SUM(A1,-A2), recalculated and then deliberately edited to =1/0; erroneous bytes remain real and submitted.
interpretation.history: Valid and invalid A submissions belong to separate declared work items. The old submission retains its exact immutable version after the current workbook becomes erroneous.
interpretation.institutional_boundary: Delivery-only accepted status is a recorded policy decision. The erroneous submitted workbook is independently rejected; acceptance never substitutes for its content check.
interpretation.read_boundary: All four evaluations trace the immutable version path and compare exact object/version/hash reads with the fixed submitted artifact set. No hidden correct workbook is created.
interpretation.privacy_boundary: N1 contains same-project unauthorized writing and cross-project unauthorized writing controls; it is not the N3 private-upstream consumption experiment.
interpretation.no_expansion: No model/API/GPU/training, professional finance claim or crash-recovery claim is derived from these two N1 runs.

omissions: Full state snapshots are not duplicated in this archive. Their original path/sha256/bytes and version/mirror hash maps are preserved verbatim in each report and snapshot index.
Full action transcripts are kept at the raw file indexes with sha256/bytes. All returned calls remain in those original files; evaluation read_sets and results are embedded here.
Binary XLSX/JSON contents remain in the original experiment worlds and are identified by the snapshot immutable/mirror hashes; this JSON archive is not a self-contained binary backup.
